proposal_note: Internal research architecture and test specification only; not a course submission. Course instructions forbid AI-written submissions.
locking_rule: Freeze outcome, loci selection, QC thresholds and main estimands in a versioned commit before processing any discovery/evaluation results. Current configuration is prospective design, not preregistration.
research_question: At EUR-discovered ischemic stroke loci, how reproducible is ancestry-matched cis-eQTL-based gene prioritization between EUR and EAS after comparing phenotype definitions, SNP coverage, LD, and statistical power?

primary_endpoint.name: cross_ancestry_locus_to_gene_concordance
primary_endpoint.definition: Among prespecified EUR-discovered loci analyzable in BOTH EUR and EAS for the same gene and ancestry-specific cis-eQTL, report N_same_top_gene, N_different_top_gene, N_unresolved, and denominator N_both_evaluable. Report coverage N_both_evaluable / N_preselected, along with uncertainty; do not condition solely on significant EAS results.
primary_endpoint.missingness_rule: A locus with absent EAS eQTL, inadequate variants, LD or statistical power is NON_EVALUABLE, never classified as biological disagreement.
primary_endpoint.success_interpretation: Descriptive evidence of portability/stability; not causal effect of ancestry or conclusive ethnic biology.

primary_outcome.name: ischemic_stroke_susceptibility
primary_outcome.clinical_basis: Contributing cohorts may combine physician-adjudicated, TOAST and administrative ICD based ascertainment. Actual GCST accession contribution unresolved.

secondary_outcomes.name: small_vessel_stroke
secondary_outcomes.interpretation: May share cases with primary IS phenotype; no independent replication claim.

secondary_outcomes.name: cardioembolic_stroke
secondary_outcomes.interpretation: Insufficient assumed power for headline EAS mechanistic inference.

fairness_conditions: Same genome build and explicit liftover chain provenance
Document eQTL sample size, effective GWAS sample size, coverage, imputation quality and statistical power
Document phenotype ascertainment and likely overlapping samples
No selection of loci by EAS discovery statistics
anti_claims: Difference in significance is not evidence of effect heterogeneity
Colocalization is not proof of mediation
Cell-type expression does not demonstrate cell-type eQTL
Two GIGASTROKE ancestry strata are not automatically independent replication
Neither eQTL study is patient-matched to GWAS patients
A low-powered result is not negative biological evidence

analysis_methods.question: Are EUR and EAS phenotype case definitions actually comparable?
analysis_methods.method: Cohort contribution × trait × ancestry phenotyping and provenance table
analysis_methods.stop_rule: Unresolvable ascertainment heterogeneity is explicitly recorded; no ancestry-specific causal mechanism claims.

analysis_methods.question: Are source effect sizes/alleles/build and study membership suitable for analysis?
analysis_methods.method: Source checksums, header/body validation, locus extraction, palindromic & multiallelic QC
analysis_methods.stop_rule: Missing alleles/effects/build or unknowable overlap => HOLD.

analysis_methods.question: Can the same gene and variant universe be compared in both populations?
analysis_methods.method: Whole-blood eQTL access audit, matching SNP/cis-gene set, ancestry LD checks, power assessment
analysis_methods.stop_rule: No EAS full eQTL or ancestry LD => no primary comparison.

analysis_methods.question: Is there evidence GWAS and cis-eQTL share variant(s) within each ancestry?
analysis_methods.method: Fine-mapping with multi-signal aware colocalization where well-powered; PP3/PP4, credible-set quality, priors/sensitivity
analysis_methods.stop_rule: Poor conditional signals or inadequate SNP coverage => UNRESOLVED.

analysis_methods.question: Do ancestry-matched sources support the same genes?
analysis_methods.method: Compute paired locus-gene concordance/discordance + coverage/power matched sensitivity, CIs across loci
analysis_methods.stop_rule: Do not classify non-evaluable loci as discordant.

analysis_methods.question: Does locus-wise observation add to published IS/AF/eQTL work?
analysis_methods.method: Locus × gene × ancestry × prepublication matrix; independent evidence vs reused GWAS sample
analysis_methods.stop_rule: Prior published interpretation or no independent evidence => no novelty assertion.

decision_gates.label: phenotype_source_definition
decision_gates.verified_evidence: Preprint supplement examples and GWAS Catalog trait names; full accession-contribution not mapped.
decision_gates.required_to_pass: Final source supplement + contributing cohort/ascertainment by accession/outcome where recoverable.

decision_gates.label: gwas_sumstats_and_provenance
decision_gates.required_to_pass: Full EUR and EAS files verified by source hashes, build, EAF, beta/SE and mapping.

decision_gates.label: ancestry_matched_eqtl_and_ld
decision_gates.verified_evidence: Study publications identified, full data not audited.
decision_gates.required_to_pass: Both EUR/EAS full cis-eQTL variant results and appropriate matched LD reproducibly accessible.

decision_gates.label: prelocked_loci_coverage_and_power
decision_gates.required_to_pass: EUR discovery loci frozen, locus eligibility, shared SNP coverage, sensitivity power audit.

decision_gates.label: multi_signal_coloc_and_robustness
decision_gates.required_to_pass: Valid PP3/PP4, multi-signal-aware analysis and sensitivity per analyzable locus.

decision_gates.label: novelty_and_reproducibility
decision_gates.required_to_pass: Locus-wise publication comparison, independent evidence where claimed, and report all null results.

statistical_fallback: If G2 fails, EUR-only discovery interpretation with descriptive EAS GWAS effect direction; label hypothesis generation, not EAS eQTL replication.
